chapter: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Dew-Kissed Chapter
act_title: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Dew-Kissed Chapter

quests.title: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Dew-Kissed Chapter

dialogue.t: S—So cold... I definitely shouldn't have just gone out into the wind willy-nilly...
Are you okay? How'd you make it out this far all by yourself...
I'm... well... fine! I'm much better now! See, I'm not even coughing anymore.

dialogue.sit: Let me write back and check.

dialogue.t: Whoa! No need! I admit it, I sneaked out on my own! Happy?
I... I didn't have a choice. How could I possibly paint beautiful pictures if I just sat in Inazuma all the time?
Even if I have you running around taking pictures for me, picture references can't compare to seeing things with your own eyes.
So, I asked an author I worked with before to contact a merchant ship for me, and quietly hitched a ride with them so I could travel.

dialogue.sit: And you even brought all your painting tools with you...

dialogue.t: But of course! The canvas is my very soul! How could I ever abandon any of them?
Plus, my paintings are selling exceptionally well in Fontaine. A few Fontainian authors have even asked me to do the covers for their novels!
Though... Apparently putting illustrations throughout novels isn't a thing for them! Truly strange...
Oh, right... Since you happen to be here, {NICKNAME}... Would you mind helping me collect some reference materials?

dialogue.sit: Alright then, but don't go running off.

dialogue.t: Excellent! With you helping out, I know the job's as good as done.
Okay, let me have a look. As it happens, I've received a few more commissions from some authors...

quests.description: You once again encounter the illustrator Asagiri in Fontaine…
